services.name: Ghost Tour
services.desc: Join us every Saturday in March for the Progressive Women of Old Louisville walking tour, a captivating journey through the lives and legacies of the remarkable women who shaped our community. Departing from the Conrad Caldwell House Museum at 11:00 AM, this 90-minute tour will lead you through the historic streets of Old Louisville, highlighting stories of courage, innovation, and advocacy. ​Participants can expect an engaging experience as we explore the impact these women had on our city's history. The tour will happen rain or shine, so we recommend checking the local weather forecast and dressing appropriately. Comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle, and weather-appropriate gear
